scenes.score_intent: Sparse cold Victorian chamber strings and low woodwinds in a minor key, slow tempo around 60 BPM, foggy unresolved harmonies under distant muffled church bell, opens hushed and desolate then holds a thin icy drone through the narrator line without resolving
scenes.dynamics_arc: Starts near silence, rises slightly under the fog and stamping feet around clip 2, peaks softly on the door-nail line at clip 4, then sinks back to sparse drone.
scenes.timing: underscore full 35s; enter under first fog image, swell under VO, fade under last stamp
scenes.diegetic_sound: muffled coughs, distant church bell, feet stamping on wet stone, faint wheeze of fog-choked breath
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no brass, no choir, no festive melody
alternatives: solo cello drone with wind bed

scenes.score_intent: Dry pinched string quartet in cold D minor, metronomic 70 BPM ticking like a ledger clock, thin high harmonics over a miserly pizzicato bass, remains tight and ungenerous throughout with no warmth
scenes.dynamics_arc: Flat low intensity through clips 1-3 establishing the office, slight rise on Bob's candle-warming at clip 4 then holds cold.
scenes.timing: continuous bed under whole 40s; enter on firm name shot
scenes.diegetic_sound: quill scratch on paper, faint crackle of one-coal fire, candle hiss, distant fog horn
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no melody that feels kind or Christmas-like
alternatives: solo bassoon and dry snare tick

scenes.score_intent: Very sparse high violin harmonics and a single low cello note, almost static 55 BPM, cold and empty, brief dog-whimper motif then retreats to silence
scenes.dynamics_arc: Near silence at open, tiny peak on dog tug at clip 1, immediate release to emptiness by clip 2.
scenes.timing: 20s total; music only under dog moment then out
scenes.diegetic_sound: dog whimper, leash tug, fog-muffled street traffic, no human greeting
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no human voices in score, no warmth

scenes.score_intent: Opens with bright warm woodwind flourish for Fred's entrance at lively 110 BPM major, then snaps to cold dry strings and bassoon for Scrooge's Bah Humbug replies; argument section tightens with staccato strings rising in tension; charity gentlemen section colder still with hollow brass chords; climaxes on surplus-population line with a hard dissonant hit then drops to thin unresolved drone as they withdraw
scenes.dynamics_arc: Warm peak on Fred entrance clip 1, drops cold for Humbug clips 2-3, builds tension through charity exchange clips 5-7, hardest peak on surplus population clip 7, releases to cold quiet on withdraw clip 8.
scenes.timing: full 180s continuous; tempo and mode shift with each speaker turn
scenes.diegetic_sound: door bang, rush of cold air, quill scratch resume, fog horn distant, footsteps of withdrawing gentlemen
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no full orchestra until surplus hit; keep Fred's warmth brief
alternatives: piano only argument with sudden low cluster on surplus
string quartet with muted brass sting

scenes.score_intent: Grudging low strings and dry woodwinds at 65 BPM, irritable short phrases matching Scrooge's complaints, slight lift when Bob smiles then immediately flattened by Scrooge's growl, ends with cold exit figure
scenes.dynamics_arc: Low steady through stool and candle clips 1-2, small rise on half-crown complaint clip 3, peak on great-coat button and growl exit clip 5.
scenes.timing: 45s bed under dialogue; out on door close
scenes.diegetic_sound: stool scrape, candle snuff, coat buttons, door growl close
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no festive hint

scenes.score_intent: Two-part cue: first half bright playful fiddle and light percussion at 120 BPM for Bob's ice slide and run, second half drops to lonely minor cello and foggy woodwinds at 60 BPM for Scrooge's tavern and walk home
scenes.dynamics_arc: Playful peak on Cornhill slide clips 1-2, sharp drop to melancholy for Scrooge dinner and walk clips 3-4.
scenes.timing: 40s; hard crossfade at midpoint when Scrooge appears
scenes.diegetic_sound: ice scrape, boys' shouts, running feet, tavern murmur, fog wind
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no overlap of bright and cold moods
alternatives: accordion for Bob then solo horn for Scrooge
diegetic only for slide then sparse score

scenes.score_intent: Opens with low ominous drone and distant wind at 50 BPM, builds with rising dissonant string clusters and metallic scrape as knocker transforms into Marley's face, sharp stinger on the face reveal then sudden cut to near silence when knocker is normal again
scenes.dynamics_arc: Hushed dread clips 1-3, sharp peak on Marley face clip 4, abrupt release to silence clip 5.
scenes.timing: 35s; stinger exact on face lock, silence after
scenes.diegetic_sound: wind moan, distant drip, key rattle, sharp breath, sudden silence
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no melody, no choir yet
alternatives: prepared piano scrape and low brass
only wind and heartbeat then stinger

scenes.score_intent: Long gothic cue: begins sparse after lock with uneasy low strings; bells section erupts into cascading dissonant tubular bells and full orchestra at 80 BPM; chain clank motif of heavy metallic percussion and low brass; Marley dialogue underscored by hollow choir pads and grinding cellos; jaw-drop hit with full orchestral stab; mankind-was-my-business builds to anguished brass climax; three-spirits warning holds tense pedal; window phantoms swell with wailing high strings then fade to exhausted quiet as Scrooge sleeps
scenes.dynamics_arc: Low tension clips 1-4, rises hard on bells and chain clips 5-7, peaks on jaw drop and business cry clips 8-10, secondary peak on three spirits clip 11, long release through phantoms to sleep clip 13.
scenes.timing: continuous 240s; major hits locked to bells, chain entrance, jaw, chain crash, spirit warning
scenes.diegetic_sound: door bang echoes, fire spit, gruel simmer, every bell pealing, chain drag and clank, jaw clack, heavy chain crash, window rise, wailing spirits, wind
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: brief near-silence only after phantoms fade before sleep
alternatives: string orchestra with industrial metal percussion for chain

scenes.score_intent: Dark bedroom opens with slow heartbeat timpani and distant clock chimes building from 50 to 70 BPM through the quarters; at the deep ONE a sudden radiant but eerie orchestral bloom with celesta, harp, and high strings as Past appears; light ethereal motif with fluctuating irregular meter matching the Spirit's shifting form; gentle lift on heart touch then whoosh through wall
scenes.dynamics_arc: Tense quiet clips 1-3, builds through chimes, peaks on ONE and Past reveal clip 5, softens on touch and wall passage clip 6.
scenes.timing: 70s; chime hits exact, bloom on ONE, ethereal bed under Past
scenes.diegetic_sound: heavy church bell to twelve, repeater tick, quarters ding-dong, deep ONE, rush of light, soft fabric of curtains
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no heavy brass after Past appears
alternatives: music-box into full strings on ONE
only bells then pure celesta for Past

scenes.score_intent: Clear cold major-key pastoral with flute, oboe, and light strings at gentle 80 BPM, snow-bright and nostalgic, soft swell when Scrooge weeps in recognition then returns to open airy texture
scenes.dynamics_arc: Open bright clips 1-2, emotional peak on recognition and tears clip 4, soft release clip 5.
scenes.timing: 40s continuous pastoral bed
scenes.diegetic_sound: crisp air, boys shouting Merry Christmas, pony hooves, cart wheels on frozen road
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no darkness, keep daylight clarity

scenes.score_intent: Opens lonely and bare with solo piano and thin strings in minor for the neglected boy; brief playful woodwind flourishes for Ali Baba vision; sudden warm major lift with gentle strings and clarinet when Fan enters and kisses; tender swell on home-for-good dialogue; bittersweet cadence when Ghost notes she died a woman and mother of the nephew
scenes.dynamics_arc: Lonely low clips 1-3, playful bump clip 4, warm peak on Fan entrance and embrace clips 5-6, tender secondary peak on large-heart/nephew reveal clip 8.
scenes.timing: 90s; mode shift hard on Fan door burst
scenes.diegetic_sound: mouse scuffle, water-spout drip, empty door swing, door burst, child laugh, coach wheels
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: keep school bare until Fan
alternatives: solo violin lonely then duet with cello for Fan
music-box for boy then full warm strings

scenes.score_intent: Brief transitional cue of bustling city strings and light percussion at 100 BPM with Christmas-market sparkle, short and purposeful leading into warehouse door
scenes.dynamics_arc: Steady medium energy clips 1-2, slight lift on known door clip 3.
scenes.timing: 20s bridge only
scenes.diegetic_sound: carts coaches, shadowy crowd murmur, street lamps hiss
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no long melody
alternatives: diegetic street bed with light score

scenes.score_intent: Joyful full dance cue: starts with Fezziwig's jovial low brass and fiddle at lively 120 BPM; shutters and clear-away build with accelerating percussion; full country-dance orchestra for Sir Roger de Coverley with bright strings woodwinds and handclaps; calves-shine moment gets playful brass winks; eleven o'clock winds down warmly; tender reflective strings when Scrooge defends the happiness Fezziwig gives; soft resolve on wish to speak to clerk
scenes.dynamics_arc: Jovial open clips 1-2, builds through dance clips 3-5, peak on full dance and cut clip 5, warm reflective peak on happiness speech clip 7, gentle release clip 8.

scenes.score_intent: Intimate tragic chamber cue in slow 60 BPM: soft minor strings and solo clarinet for Belle in mourning; dialogue underscored with restrained aching harmonies; slight harden when golden idol named; long dying fall as she releases him and leaves; Scrooge's beg for no more sits on unresolved high string
scenes.dynamics_arc: Soft ache clips 1-2, tension rise on idol and changed nature clips 3-5, emotional peak on release and farewell clip 6, held pain on Scrooge beg clip 7.
scenes.timing: 90s continuous intimate bed
scenes.diegetic_sound: soft winter quiet, fabric of mourning dress, quiet tears, footsteps leaving
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no large orchestra, no percussion

scenes.score_intent: Opens warm domestic major with children's laughter motifs in woodwinds and light strings; Christmas toys arrival brightens further; then darkens sharply when husband names solitary Scrooge; struggle with Past becomes violent orchestral thrash with extinguisher whoosh; light streams under cap as unresolved high cluster; collapses to exhausted low drone as Scrooge reels to bed
scenes.dynamics_arc: Warm joy clips 1-2, dark turn clip 3, violent peak on wrestle and extinguisher clips 5-6, collapse release clip 7.
scenes.timing: 70s; hard gear-shift at Scrooge alone mention
scenes.diegetic_sound: children uproar, knock, shouts of wonder, struggle grunts, light hiss, bed creak
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: cut festive color the instant struggle begins
alternatives: warm piano then sudden full orchestra hit
diegetic kids then score only on struggle

scenes.score_intent: Uneasy waiting cue: low pulse and sparse piano at 55 BPM, snore cut-off, clock tension building toward One, then sudden warm ruddy glow pad with low brass as light floods from next room; voice call sits on held chord
scenes.dynamics_arc: Low tension clips 1-4, rise on light blaze clip 5, soft peak on voice call enter clip 6.
scenes.timing: 35s; light bloom exact on adjoining glow
scenes.diegetic_sound: tough snore cut short, clock toward One, silence of waiting, soft shuffle slippers, strange voice
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: long near-silence during wait
alternatives: only clock and heartbeat then warm pad

scenes.score_intent: Glorious abundant Christmas cue: erupts on room reveal with full warm orchestra, sleigh bells, rich brass and choir ahs at majestic 90 BPM; throne of food gets lavish harp and celesta sparkle; Present's genial theme on horns and strings; eighteen-hundred brothers line broadens; touch-robe moment whooshes everything away into sudden thin air

scenes.timing: 60s; full bloom on first green reveal, hard out on vanish

scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no darkness in this cue

scenes.score_intent: Bustling joyful Christmas morning scherzo at 115 BPM with bright strings, woodwinds, and market percussion; snow-scrape rhythms; radiant shop fanfares; church-bell overlays; baker doorway moment softens to gentle blessing motif with soft choir; Seventh Day dialogue cools briefly then returns to open cheerful stride
scenes.dynamics_arc: High energy clips 1-4, softens on torch blessing clip 6, slight cool on dialogue clip 8, returns bright.
scenes.timing: 90s continuous festive bed with dynamic dips
scenes.diegetic_sound: snow scrapes, church bells, cheerful calls, basket crashes, oven steam, torch sprinkle
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: keep blessing moment intimate not bombastic
alternatives: folk band with fiddle and drum

scenes.score_intent: Warm domestic Christmas cue opening with gentle strings and clarinet for Cratchit home; playful woodwinds for Martha hide and children; tender cello for Tim on shoulder and crutch; goose and pudding build to joyful full family tutti with light choir; God-bless-us-every-one lands as pure simple cadence; vacant-seat prophecy darkens with sudden minor and thin high strings; surplus quote hits with cold echo of earlier Scrooge motif; toast section awkward then recovers warmth; final torch fade holds eye-on-Tim with soft unresolved hope
scenes.dynamics_arc: Warm build clips 1-5, joyful peak on goose pudding and blessing clips 5-6, dark drop on vacant seat and surplus clips 7-8, awkward toast clip 9, tender release on Tim fade clip 10.
scenes.timing: 180s continuous with clear emotional turns locked to prophecy and toast
scenes.diegetic_sound: cloth snap, potato bubble, children screams, crutch on floor, gravy hiss, brandy whoosh, delighted cries, quiet after toast
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: strip warmth completely under vacant-seat lines
alternatives: solo piano family theme with string swells

scenes.score_intent: Bleak open fifths and cold wind-like strings at slow 55 BPM for moor; distant rough male choir and simple folk melody rises from hut as generations sing; holds rugged warmth against howling exterior then fades as Spirit moves on
scenes.dynamics_arc: Desolate open clips 1-2, warm peak on hut song clip 4, fade out.
scenes.timing: 40s; song enters with firelight
scenes.diegetic_sound: howling wind on barren waste, old song rising over wind, fire crackle
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no polished choir, keep folk rough

scenes.score_intent: Storm-lashed low brass and timpani with crashing wave percussion at 70 BPM; inside the light a sturdy sea-shanty style male duet motif over warm fire chords; ends with gale-force swell

scenes.score_intent: Dark heaving sea bed of low strings and woodwind swells at slow 60 BPM; quiet hummed Christmas fragments from crew; sudden bright warm laugh motif (Fred's theme) cuts through like light, leading hard into next scene

scenes.timing: 30s; laugh stinger exact
scenes.diegetic_sound: wind moan, creak of timber, low humming, sudden hearty laugh
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no full festive until laugh

scenes.score_intent: Bright party scherzo at 120 BPM with sparkling strings, piano, and laughter hits for Fred's room; blind-man's-buff playful chase music; harp air quotes Fan's earlier tender theme softening Scrooge; Yes-and-No builds comic tension to explosive laugh peak on Uncle Scrooge reveal; warm toast cadence; then Ghost ages with darkening low strings; Ignorance and Want emerge under grinding dissonant cluster and children's ragged breath motif; Are-there-no-prisons echoes cold Scrooge motif; twelve bells crash and Present vanishes into silence
scenes.dynamics_arc: High joy clips 1-4, tender dip on harp clip 5, comic peak on Yes-No reveal clip 6, warm toast clip 7, darkening clips 8-9, horror peak on Want children clip 9, final crash on twelve clip 11.
scenes.timing: 150s continuous with multiple gear-shifts; bells exact at end
scenes.diegetic_sound: contagious laughter, fire crackle, glasses, blind-man's buff bumps, harp notes, chimes three-quarters, twelve deep strokes, children's ragged breath
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: strip all party color under Ignorance Want
alternatives: chamber party band then full orchestra horror

scenes.score_intent: Near-silent dread: ultra-low organ pedal and slow approaching drum at 40 BPM; mist textures of clustered strings; Scrooge kneel gets hollow choir breath; Lead-on vow adds a thin thread of determined low brass that does not resolve

scenes.score_intent: Squalid grotesque cue: wheezing accordion and scraped strings at lurching 70 BPM; Old Joe pipe smoke drone; scavengers' entrance comic-macabre woodwinds; bed-curtains reveal builds with rising disgust clusters; shirt-off-corpse line hits hard dissonance; Ha-ha profit-us laugh becomes distorted full orchestral sneer; Scrooge horror reaction drops to sickened low strings
